posts.en:
dsh-approval-gate is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Risk-gated approval automation for DeepSeek Harness: flash pre-classifies whether a write/command is irreversible — safe operations are auto-approved, dangerous ones are escalated to human approval (fail-safe).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-903165ddbc134f8cb6cd.html
